points.quote: **`common`**: Plain JavaScript and TypeScript that runs anywhere. It can't use DOM APIs or Node APIs.
**`browser`**: Code that needs the DOM and browser APIs ... **`browser`** may import `common` and `browser`.
**`node`**: Code that needs Node.js APIs, such as `fs`, `child_process` and `net`. ... **`node`** may import `common` and `node`.

**`electron-browser`**: The Electron renderer process. It has the DOM plus Electron and Node access through preload and IPC. ... **`electron-browser`** may import `common`, `browser` and `electron-browser`.
**`electron-main`** may import `common`, `node` and `electron-main`. It must not import `browser` or `electron-browser`.
